description: The post-effects section of the Eagan Matrix: output level, a global mute, and the tilt equaliser; it works through a CHEM Core

params.text: Sets the output level of the instrument, 0-10V
Sets how much of the equalised signal is mixed with the flat signal
Tilts the equaliser, taking the low end up and the high end down to one side of centre and the other way to the other side
Sets the frequency the equaliser tilts about
Sets how far the voltage at the selected input moves its control, from -100% to 100%, a negative amount inverting the voltage; the knob does nothing until a cable is patched
Silences everything coming out of the instrument, and lights red while it does

inputs.text: Moves the output level away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves the equaliser mix away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves the equaliser tilt away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves the equaliser frequency away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
A rising edge flips the mute on or off; it reads high above 5V and low below 0.1V

notes: nothing reaches the instrument until the module is linked to a CHEM Core; putting it beside a linked CHEM module links it, or click the link button at the bottom of the panel to pick a Core
one input at a time is under the modulation amount knob; patching a cable moves the knob to that jack and lights the lamp beside it, and clicking a jack or its label moves the knob to that one
menu: Zero modulation — sets the modulation amount on every input of this module to zero
Center knobs — sets the equaliser mix, tilt and frequency knobs to the middle of their range
